bookSubtitle: Maze Activity Book with Fun Challenges
missionStartText: HELP THE PUPPY FIND HIS WAY HOME
screenFreeText: A fun screen-free activity book for young kids.
bookIntroText:
Help the puppy find his way home!

First, find the bone. Then follow the path to the house.

Stay inside the maze lines and have fun solving all 50 mazes!
howToFooter: Use a pencil and have fun!
howToLines:
Start at the puppy.
Find the bone first.
Then go to the house.
Stay inside the maze lines.
Solve all 50 mazes!
tipText: Tip: Use a pencil so you can try again!
mazePageSubtitle: Help the puppy find the bone and reach the house!
solutionSubtitle: Follow the dashed path to check your answer.
